item.title: New coach aims to strike right note with contending London Beefeaters
item.description: Scott Wilkinson loves the sound of his gig with the London Beefeaters.

item.title: Officers hurt after driver runs red light, collides with London police vehicle
item.description: A man is facing drunk driving charges after a driver collided with an unmarked London police vehicle in the west end of the city on Monday night.

item.title: Workers say they're owed pay after London restaurant's abrupt closing
item.description: Employees who lost their jobs when a popular London restaurant abruptly closed say they still haven't received their final pay from the business's owners.

item.title: London man charged in fatal shooting was on bail facing gun charges
item.description: Court records show the accused had been released less than two months earlier on handgun-related charges.

item.title: Four London Knights named among CHL's top 50 players of last 50 years
item.description: Four Knights graduates were among those selected during the league’s 50th anniversary season.

item.title: Union rejects absenteeism claim in Thames Valley special education deficit
item.description: The union says sick leave tied to workplace injuries is being mischaracterized as absenteeism.

item.title: Two London men charged after masked break-in attempt downtown
item.description: London police recovered ski masks, a hatchet and knives that were discarded by the men as they fled.

item.title: Explosives probe: Day-long bail hearing ends without decision
item.description: Fei (Frank) Han, one of four people charged in a chemicals and gun case in London, is seeking his release from custody

item.title: 19-year-old killed after snowmobile hits tree: OPP
item.description: The crash happened late Monday on a North Perth snowmobile trail.

item.title: Ice-storm alerts won’t trigger Boyle warming centre opening
item.description: City council asked staff to study whether weather alerts could be used in the future.
